name: Pedro Sancho
description: Pedro variant (also called Nine-Five) for four to seven players. Six cards each; one round of bidding (0–18). High bidder names trumps; the 5 (pedro) and 9 (sancho) of that suit score 5 and 9 points. First to 100 wins. Bidder must lead trump; follow suit when trump is led.

overview.description: Pedro variant (also called Nine-Five) for four to seven players. Six cards each; one round of bidding (0–18). High bidder names trumps; the 5 (pedro) and 9 (sancho) of that suit score 5 and 9 points. First to 100 wins. Bidder must lead trump; follow suit when trump is led.

history.origins: Pedro variant from the USA; a trick-taking game with 5 and 9 as permanent trumps.
timeline: 19th century: Pedro and Cinch developed in North America from All Fours; Pedro Sancho (Nine-Five) is a variant with 5 and 9 as scoring trumps.

setup.players: Four to seven; four may play as two partnerships (partners opposite).
setup.dealing: Six cards each (most sources); some deal as far as cards go evenly. One round of bidding; dealer may take the bid by equalling the highest. High bidder declares trump.

rules.objective: As a team or individually, be the first to reach 100 points by winning tricks containing scoring trumps: high (trump ace), low (trump two), jack (trump jack), game (trump ten), pedro (trump five, 5 points) and sancho (trump nine, 9 points). Total 18 points per deal. If the bid is made, score the points won; if the bid fails, the bidder loses the number of points bid.
rules.gameplay: Six cards each. One round of bidding (no minimum, max 18); dealer may take the bid by equalling the highest bid. High bidder names trumps and must lead a trump to the first trick. If a trump is led, everyone must play a trump if able; if a non-trump is led, players may follow suit or trump. Trick won by highest trump, or highest card of led suit if no trumps. Winner of each trick leads to the next. Points are counted in order: high, low, jack, game, pedro, sancho.

scoring.description: Scoring trumps: high (A) 1, low (2) 1, jack 1, game (10) 1, pedro (5) 5, sancho (9) 9; total 18 per deal. Counted in that order. If bid is made, team scores points won; if bid fails, bidder loses the amount bid. First to 100 wins.
scoring.winCondition: First player or team to reach 100 points. If bid is made, add points won to total; if bid fails, subtract the bid from bidder's total.

synthesis.shortDescription: Pedro variant: 5 and 9 are trumps (Pedro Sancho / Nine-Five).
